title: ali ka darwaza
body:
Bhala azeem hai kitna, Ali ka darvaza
Fazilato ne bhi dhoundha, Ali ka darvaza
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Khade the log bohot intezar me lekin
Sitaara dekh ke utra Ali ka darvaza
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Nabi ke shehr me tum kis tarha se jaoge
Ke raaste me padega Ali ka darvaza
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Qasam hai qaanae Kaba tere tabassum ki
Khuda ke ghar me bhi dekha Ali ka darvaza
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Halakato se bachane ke waaste khud ko
Fala'n fala'n ne bhi dhoundha Ali ka darvaza
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Muqaalefeen bhi ye soch kar yaha'n pohche
Kabhi na band milega Ali ka darvaza
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Rasool jab shabe meraj arsh par pohche
Faraaze arsh pe dekha Ali ka darvaza
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jo dushmanane Ali hai, kaha'n vo jaenge
Dare jina pe hai likkha Ali ka darvaza
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Bilal Buzaro Salman sabhi khade the vahan
Jo mayne ghor se dekha Ali ka darvaza
